::: {#exm-hers-odds-ratio-cross-product}

#### The HERS odds ratio from the cell proportions

Take $X = 1$ for hormone therapy and $X = 0$ for placebo, and $Y = 1$ for regular exercise.
The estimated joint probabilities are the cell proportions of the HERS table:

```{r}
#| label: hers-or-cross-product
#| code-fold: false
joint_hat <- prop.table(table(HT = hers$HT, exercise = hers$exercise))
cross_ratio <-
  joint_hat["hormone therapy", "yes"] * joint_hat["placebo", "no"] /
  (joint_hat["hormone therapy", "no"] * joint_hat["placebo", "yes"])
cross_ratio
```

The ratio of cross products is `r round(cross_ratio, 3)`.
It equals the estimated odds ratio `r round(or_hat, 3)` of @exm-hers-odds-ratio, as @thm-odds-ratio-cross-product states.
:::
